statement: Build a one-file, phone-friendly website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse products by category, filter by size and price, read the size guide, see new arrivals, order on WhatsApp, view a lookbook, and find the shop's timings, location, return and exchange policy, delivery details and customer reviews.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: warm natural colours, calm spacing, serif or refined headings, defined as CSS variables
Mobile first: viewport meta tag set, readable text and tap-friendly buttons at 360px, no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Prices shown in rupees (₹) exactly as supplied
No JavaScript errors, no broken in-page links, forms and filters work
rules: Use only facts the Requester supplied; do not invent products, prices, reviews, policies, offers or contact details
No photos or stock images: every product and lookbook outfit gets an empty photo spot
Lookbook outfits use only the 10 listed products
Orders go through WhatsApp using the supplied order number; the shop phone is shown separately for calls
done_when: The file shows the name Thread & Loom and Pune in the page title and header, with a navigation to every section

Four categories (Kurtas, Sarees, Shirts, Dupattas) are browsable and the file lists exactly these 10 products with these prices: Indigo block-print kurta ₹1,499; Mustard handloom kurta ₹1,699; White chikankari kurta ₹2,199; Maheshwari cotton saree ₹3,499; Chanderi silk-cotton saree ₹4,999; Ikat handloom saree ₹3,999; Khadi cotton shirt ₹1,299; Linen-blend shirt ₹1,599; Ajrakh dupatta ₹899; Bandhani dupatta ₹1,099
Product sizes in the file are: Indigo kurta S-XXL, Mustard kurta S-XL, White chikankari kurta XS-XL, Khadi shirt S-XXL, Linen-blend shirt M-XXL, and free size for all three sarees and both dupattas
A size filter and a price filter in the file's script narrow the visible products, and the free size items are reachable through the size filter
A size guide table lists chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42
A New Arrivals section shows the White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree and Linen-blend shirt
Every product has an Order on WhatsApp link to wa.me/910000011111 with a pre-filled message containing the product name
A Lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits, each built only from the listed products, each with an empty photo spot
Every product card and every lookbook outfit has an empty photo spot and no image file or stock photo is used
A visit section shows the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, the timings 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday with Monday closed, and the shop phone +91 00000 22222 as a tap-to-call link
The return and exchange policy states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, and no returns on sale items
A reviews section shows three reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
A delivery section states: delivery across Pune in 2 days, ₹79 charge, free above ₹2,999, pay on delivery or UPI
The file has a viewport meta tag and CSS that prevents horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, with an earthy colour palette set in CSS variables
The script runs without errors and every in-page link points to an existing section id
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
See delivery charges and payment options
